definitions.gloss: to go to the United States; to travel to America
definitions.explanation: To travel to or move to the United States. Used for both short trips and longer relocations. A formal word commonly seen in news and biographical writing.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}{渡米|とべい}する{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: I plan to go to the United States next month.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{留学|りゅうがく}のために{渡米|とべい}した。
examples.english: She went to the United States to study abroad.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}くして{渡米|とべい}し、{現地|げんち}の{大学|だいがく}で{医学|いがく}を{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: He went to America at a young age and studied medicine at a university there.

notes:
Formed from {渡|と} (to cross over) + {米|べい} (America, short for {米国|べいこく}). This pattern of {渡|と} + country abbreviation is productive in Japanese.

ETYMOLOGY:
The {渡|と} prefix originally referred to crossing the sea. {米|べい} is the single-character abbreviation for America ({米国|べいこく}).

RELATED COUNTRY-CROSSING WORDS:
- {渡英|とえい}する: to go to Britain
- {渡仏|とふつ}する: to go to France
- {渡独|とどく}する: to go to Germany
- {渡航|とこう}する: to travel abroad (general)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {渡航|とこう}する: to travel overseas — general term for international travel; not country-specific
- アメリカに{行|い}く: to go to America — everyday, casual equivalent
